question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who loves or collects books
solution:
The correct answer is: Bibliophile.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bibliophile"** refers to a person who loves or collects books. (पुस्तक प्रेमी)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a true **bibliophile**, with a collection of rare first editions.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for a person who loves or collects books is **'Bibliophile'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anglophile** (अंग्रेज़ प्रेमी): A person who admires England or things English.

 
 
• **Example:** He is an **Anglophile **who enjoys British literature and culture.
 
 
 
• **Heliophile** (सूर्य प्रेमी): A person who loves sunlight.
 
 
• **Example:** As a **heliophile**, she spends most of her day outdoors soaking up the sun.
 
 
 
• **Paedophile** (बाल-प्रेमी): A person who is sexually attracted to children.
 
 
• **Example:** The community was alarmed when they discovered a **paedophile **was living in the neighbourhood.
